title: A Little Bag for Tea
paras: Long ago, people made [[tea|tea]] with loose leaves. They put the leaves in a pot and added hot water. Then they poured the drink into cups. Sometimes small leaves went into the cups too. People wanted an easier way to make their [[favorite|favorite]] hot drink. One [[idea|idea]] was to put the leaves inside a small bag. Water could go through it, but the leaves stayed inside.

In the early 1900s, people began to use small bags for this drink. Some early bags were made from cloth. Later, makers began to [[change|change]] the bags. They used special paper instead. A [[machine|machine]] could fill many bags in a short time. More people could [[get|get]] them in shops. The bags became common in many countries, including [[australia|Australia]].

Many bags now have a string and a small paper tag. Makers can [[draw|draw]] pictures on these tags. To make a cup, you put a bag [[down|down]] into it and add hot water. After a few minutes, your drink is [[ready|ready]]. You lift the bag out by its string. This little bag made an old daily job easier.
zh: 很久以前，人们用散茶叶泡茶。他们把茶叶放进茶壶，加入热水，然后把茶倒进杯子。有时，细小的茶叶也会进入杯子。人们想用更简单的方法来泡自己最喜欢的热饮。有一个主意是把茶叶装进小袋子里。水可以穿过袋子，茶叶却留在里面。
20世纪初，人们开始用小袋子泡茶。有些早期的茶袋是布做的。后来，制作者开始改变茶袋的做法，改用一种特殊的纸。机器能在短时间内装满许多茶袋。更多人能在商店里买到它们。茶袋在许多国家变得常见，其中包括澳大利亚。
现在，许多茶袋都带有一根线和一个小纸标签。制作者可以在这些标签上画图。泡茶时，把茶袋放进杯子里，再加入热水。几分钟后，茶就泡好了。你拉着线把茶袋提出来。这个小袋子让一件古老的日常小事变得更简单了。

q.s: Small tea leaves sometimes went into people's cups.
q.why: 第一段说细小的茶叶有时会进入杯子。

q.s: Tea bag makers changed from paper bags to cloth bags.
q.why: 第二段说早期用布，后来改用特殊的纸。

q.s: Pictures of flowers are the most popular pictures on tea bag tags.
q.why: 第三段只说可以画图，未提哪种图最受欢迎。
